title: Stellarnet private offer: term bridge, approval path, and activation steps
text:
Stellarnet private offer: term bridge, approval path, and activation steps

["From: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@stellarnet.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private Offer for Stellarnet — pricing and approvals

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Stellarnet is interested in a private offer on AWS Marketplace. Two quick asks before we loop procurement:

1) Can you give a short price comparison for a 12‑month vs 24‑month commitment (list price, discount, and any co‑sell credit assumptions)?
2) What approvals do we need on the buyer side to activate a Marketplace private offer? Our procurement lead says CFO signoff is sometimes required; is there a $ threshold we should be aware of?

We may want to bring Redwood sales and co‑sell into the PO flow. If you can send a brief note on activation steps and the typical legal/procurement routings, that would be great.

Procurement POC is TBD but I'll forward once confirmed.

Thanks,
Ari Kaplan
Head of Cloud Partnerships — Stellarnet
ari.kaplan@stellarnet.com
", 'From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@stellarnet.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-20T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer for Stellarnet — pricing and approvals

Ari — thanks, happy to outline. High level below and attaching a simple proposal (RNW‑proposal‑stellarnet‑v1.pdf).

Pricing (summary):
- 12‑month: $180k list, 20% standard enterprise discount => $144k ARR equivalent; co‑sell credit typical assumption = 10% rebate applied to list for partner compensation.
- 24‑month: $320k list, 25% discount => $240k effective; co‑sell credit typically unchanged (we model on list).

Buyer approvals / activation notes:
- Marketplace private offers require buyer acceptance in the console + PO submission.
- Activation thresholds: for orders > $250k we often see CFO/Finance approval; procurement/legal will review T&Cs and may request limited term edits.
- Co‑sell: complete the co‑sell credit form early so AWS knows to route credits/commitments.

Suggested next steps:
1) If you prefer speed, start with a 12‑month PO and use an accelerated activation path; alternately, an 18‑month bridge often helps match buyer budget and keeps ARR in the 12–24 conversation.
2) Send procurement POC and we’ll issue a Marketplace Private Offer (Seller console) and a DocuSign for signature if needed.
3) CC finance@stellarnet (or CFO) if the order approaches $250k.

Attaching: RNW‑proposal‑stellarnet‑v1.pdf (price tables and activation checklist).

I’ll pause on formal pricing until we get procurement contact and confirm whether they want a single annual invoice or monthly usage billing.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0198
', 'From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-21T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer for Stellarnet — pricing and approvals

Quick internal note for the thread — routing + approvals we typically see:

- <$100k: procurement approval only, standard marketplace activation (seller triggers PO, buyer accepts).
- $100k–$250k: procurement + procurement legal review; sometimes procurement negotiates PS/implementation SLAs.
- >$250k: CFO/Head of Finance signoff typical and procurement legal escalate to formal redline process.

Co‑sell specifics:
- Request buyer to complete co‑sell credit form (I attached a template separately). AWS needs that before credit allocation is confirmed.
- We should confirm whether this is a seller‑led private offer or seller+co‑sell; co‑sell means we coordinate AWS AE for credits/intro.

Pricing lens: 18‑month compromise often helps close — lower annual spend vs 12m but avoids committing 2yrs. Recommend we propose 18m with a midline discount (22–23%).

@Marcus — can you confirm co‑sell availability for the Stellarnet region and whether we can commit to a 10% co‑sell credit on list?

Thanks — V.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Marketplace Sales — Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
', 'From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-21T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer for Stellarnet — pricing and approvals

Vanessa — we can support co‑sell here. Confirming: 10% co‑sell credit on list is OK, subject to AWS AE signoff. I’m happy to loop the AE once procurement POC is in the thread.

Pricing/term suggestion:
- Propose 18‑month private offer at 22% discount (list $270k => net $210.6k). That sits between the 12m and 24m asks and usually clears procurement headroom.
- Marketplace activation: if buyer accepts the private offer in console, activation is immediate. Some buyers opt for a manual review; expect 0–7 business days review window depending on seller/buyer history.

I attached the co‑sell credit form we use as a stub (co‑sell‑credit‑form.pdf). @Karthik — can you review the net pricing impact and confirm whether Finance needs the invoice cadence changed for this structure?

—Marcus
', 'From: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@stellarnet.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@stellarnet.com
Date: 2028-07-22T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer for Stellarnet — pricing and approvals

Olga / team — thanks for the clarity. Stellarnet is prepared to move forward on an 18‑month term at the 22% discount you suggested (please itemize list vs net and co‑sell assumptions in the PO). Procurement POC here: procurement@stellarnet.com (Kara Nguyen).

We will need an invoice schedule: prefer a single annual invoice at contract start but can discuss quarterly if Redwood needs it. CFO will review (we’ll loop finance if total exceeds $200k).

Please issue the Marketplace private offer and send the DocuSign for signatures. Once we have the PO details and DocuSign, Kara will route for approval.

Thanks,
Ari Kaplan
', 'From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@stellarnet.com>, procurement@stellarnet.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer for Stellarnet — pricing and approvals

Ari / Kara — great, we’ll issue the 18‑month private offer and follow the checklist below:

1) We will create the AWS Marketplace Private Offer (seller console) with:
   - Term: 18 months
   - List price: $270,000
   - Discount: 22% => Net: $210,600
   - Co‑sell credit: 10% of list (assumption; final after AWS AE signoff)
2) DocuSign: you’ll receive a DocuSign for signature (link included below).
3) Invoice cadence: default = annual invoice at start. If procurement requests quarterly we can accommodate; please confirm in your PO metadata.
4) Activation timeline: once buyer accepts in the console, activation is immediate unless AWS triggers a manual review (0–7 bd). Expect full activation within 3 business days in most cases.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/fake-docusign-stellarnet-20280722
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/record/DL-2028-0913

Attachments: RNW‑PO‑invoice.pdf (formal invoice stub), RNW‑proposal‑stellarnet‑v1.pdf, co‑sell‑credit‑form.pdf

@Kara — once procurement accepts, please reply‑all with the exact PO number and preferred invoice cadence and we’ll push the private offer into AWS.

Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0198
